items.title: Henry A. "Hank" Kmen Interview, 1963-02-13
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] Well, Pete Fountain, when they gave this Welcome Back Pete concert over at Macalice, he said it was French bread that he longed all night in. [INTERVIEWEE] Yeah.
